def _parse_def_item(block: 'BlockParser', m: Match[str]) ->Iterable[Dict[
    str, Any]]:
    src = m.group(0)
    
    # Split the content into head and definitions
    lines = src.split('\n')
    i = 0
    
    # Process definition terms (head)
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        if line.startswith(':'):
            break
        if line.strip():
            yield {
                'type': 'def_list_head',
                'children': _process_text(block, line, False),
            }
        i += 1
    
    # Process definition descriptions (dd content)
    if i < len(lines):
        # Collect all description lines that start with ':'
        desc_lines = []
        while i < len(lines):
            line = lines[i]
            if line.startswith(':'):
                # Remove the leading ': ' and add to description
                content = line[2:].strip() if len(line) > 2 else ''
                if content:
                    desc_lines.append(content)
            elif line.strip():  # If it's a continuation line
                desc_lines.append(line.strip())
            i += 1
        
        if desc_lines:
            # Join all description lines and process as one item
            desc_content = '\n'.join(desc_lines)
            yield {
                'type': 'def_list_item',
                'children': _process_text(block, desc_content, False),
            }
